title: mineflayer-pathfinder lib/goto.js — named rejection errors
content_excerpt: goto() listens for goal_reached, path_update, goal_updated and path_stop, then rejects with named errors: NoPath ('No path to the goal!') on status noPath; Timeout ('Took to long to decide path to goal!') on status timeout; GoalChanged ('The goal was changed before it could be completed!'); PathStopped ('Path was stopped before it could be completed! Thus, the desired goal was not reached.'). A 'success' result with an empty path resolves immediately because the goal is already met.
evidence_notes: 错误名 err.name 是稳定的错误码，应作为 tool_guide 的 failure_modes 键。关键区分：Timeout 表示“规划超时”而不是“走不到”，NoPath 才表示搜索空间内无解；PathStopped 表示被外部停止，三者恢复动作不同。
related_game_versions: mineflayer-pathfinder 主线（与 mineflayer 支持版本同步）
notes: 源码级证据，可直接作为错误码契约；不覆盖服务端拒绝路径的情况。
